item.title: [threat-intel] China-Linked TA416 Targets European Governments with PlugX and OAuth-Based Phishing
item.description: A China-aligned threat actor has set its sights on European government and diplomatic organizations since mid-2025,&nbsp;following a two-year&nbsp;period of minimal targeting in the&nbsp;region.
